title: Model routes and access tiers got a reset
summary:
Model access, request queueing, and API guidance got more consistent, while a new image model and community projects gave people more to build with.

Anonymous requests default to the anonymous tier, with access to `openai`, `openai-fast`, MIDIjourney, Elixpo Search, and now Bidara. The week's routing changes settled on GPT-4o mini for `openai`, GPT-4.1 for `openai-large`, and GPT-4.1 nano for `openai-fast` and `openai-roblox`. Unknown text models return 404; insufficient access returns 402.

Text and image requests now share per-IP concurrency limits: 1 anonymous, 3 seed, 10 flower, and 30 nectar. Token-backed image requests are no longer limited to one at a time, while nectar requests use the queue too. Token-validation and referrer caching reduce repeated lookups.

Seed-tier users gained `model=kontext` for voxel-art generation from a prompt or supplied image URL, with output capped at 640 pixels on the longest side. The API docs gained Kontext image-to-image examples alongside clearer authentication and tier guidance and broader multimodal examples.

The listings gained RETIME, an accessible, time-bending text adventure; YankoviC's AI-assisted Accordion IDE; PairFusion's collaborative IDE; and Argent Script, a text-to-speech tool. Four rather different answers to what you can build with an API.
